description: This Java source file defines the class AMControl, which provides methods to launch Android activities in the background and execute shell commands related to activity management.

classes.name: AMControl
classes.description: A utility class for launching activities and executing shell commands via the ActivityManager.

methods.name: launchInBackground
methods.description: Launches an activity specified by an Intent in the background using the 'am start' command.

methods.name: execCmd
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns its output, handling process streams and logging.
